sn55.2:1.1: bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinīpātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano || ||
sn55.2:2.1: Katamehi catuhi || || Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || || Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ || pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || || 5--6. Dhamme || {Saṅgho} || || Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti || akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || ||
sn55.2:3.1: Idam avoca Bhagavā idam vatvā Sugato etad avoca satthā || ||
sn55.2:4.1: Yesaṃ saddhā ca sīlañca || pasādo dhammadassanaṃ || te ve kāle na paccanti || brahmacariyogadhaṃ sukhan ti || ||
